answer_text: Enable the Preferred IP for SIP Traffic so VoIP/SIP traffic always uses the same egress IP even with two IPs configured. This prevents mid-call IP changes from dropping calls. To enable it: for the account, go to Resources > Advanced Configuration; for a site, go to Network > Sites, select the site and Site Configuration, and enable Preferred IP for SIP Traffic. Note that existing SIP sessions may still use the old IP—reboot the affected VoIP device to trigger a new SIP flow that uses the preferred IP.
